key_insight: AI agents improved quantum compilation constructions through iterative program optimization, with every result certified by a frozen, exact verifier.
engineering_relevance: The approach could lower quantum circuit implementation costs while making automated optimization results independently checkable.
method: An agent formulates the optimization challenge with a researcher and builds an exact verifier.
Validate the verifier against a solved case, deliberately broken solutions and published results, then freeze it.
Run iterative agent optimization, retaining programs and human-readable notes for later agents to build on.
evidence_signal: Across fermion-to-qubit encoding, Hamiltonian layout and unitary synthesis, agents reduced the targeted cost by up to 73% at the largest sizes tested and outperformed a state-of-the-art fermion-to-qubit encoding optimizer.
watch_item: Exact certification depends on verifier correctness, and reductions in the optimized cost do not by themselves establish equivalent gains on quantum hardware.
paper_title: Automating quantum circuit optimization with AI agents
